contexts.name: App Shell & Navigation
contexts.description: The persistent app chrome: left nav rail, mobile nav, and the module/section registry that lets users move between CivicScore, VoteTrack, FollowTheMoney, BudgetMirror and LawWatch.

contexts.name: Landing Page
contexts.description: The public marketing/landing surface: hero story, methodology explainer, live specimen preview, standings teaser, and system module overview that introduce visitors to the five modules.

contexts.name: Velin Dashboard
contexts.description: The instrument-panel overview: chamber stat strip, the state graph (person/party/firm/money/vote/law nodes) paired with a graph-traffic feed bound to the same dataset, and a leaderboard ledger with pillar bars.

contexts.name: MP Profile Dossier
contexts.description: The single-MP file (Spis): poster header with score/trend, pillar bars, roll-call vote history with rebel markers, money ties as sourced facts, and prev/next navigation between MPs.

contexts.name: CivicScore Leaderboard
contexts.description: Ranks all 207 MPs by contribution score with a histogram, party filter, name search, per-row weighted breakdown bars, and a head-to-head comparison (Souboj) between two picked MPs.

contexts.name: LawWatch
contexts.description: Bill-to-law tracking over the 141 bills -> 101 laws amends graph: statute grouping, sponsor links, Case-1 conflict flags, the gated forensic posudek, and a standalone collisions view.

contexts.name: VoteTrack
contexts.description: Roll-call vote tracking: chronological ledger, sticky chamber detail with hemicycle + party breakdown, club discipline board with line matrix, and the rebellion chronicle.

contexts.name: BudgetMirror
contexts.description: Town-vs-peer-group budget mirror: metric duos against the computed peer median, debt-per-capita trend lines, and a sortable peer table; stewardship feeds only executive roles.

contexts.name: Money Case Files & Human Review
contexts.description: Per-MP money case files (kauzy) and the verification console where a human reviewer gates pending money ties as verified/rejected before they surface as sourced facts.

contexts.name: FollowTheMoney Graph
contexts.description: The entity-trail money graph: hover-lit edges between MPs, companies and contracts, plus kniha vazeb grouped by MP and the IC0-join/human-gate trail methodology explainer.

contexts.name: Graph Playground
contexts.description: The full knowledge graph rendered full-viewport on canvas, with two lens variants (Mapa x Trasy whole-graph landscape, Trasy standalone ledger columns), node search, and provenance/registry deep-links on node click.

contexts.name: Admin Console
contexts.description: The internal admin surface for watching ingestion/review state: loop progress grid, review hub, system state strip and vault-heads panel.

contexts.name: Ingestion Normalization
contexts.description: Shared normalization, UNL parsing and zip-extraction helpers that every source adapter relies on to turn raw feeds into consistent records before they reach the graph.

contexts.name: Source Adapters
contexts.description: Per-source ingestion adapters that pull and shape raw data from PSP, Kiosek, Dataor, Volby and Pumper into the graph's intermediate representation.

contexts.name: Sample Data Fallback
contexts.description: The deterministic mock/sample dataset (lib/civic) used as a graceful fallback whenever a real-graph loader returns null, plus the vote-scoring logic and state-graph derivation that still feed the dashboard.

contexts.name: Scoring & Verdict Copy
contexts.description: Derives the contribution index and its trend, low-score reasons, workhorse flavour text, tenure/public-facing copy, and money-feed/verdict narration shown across CivicScore, LawWatch and profiles.

contexts.name: Knowledge Graph Domain Model
contexts.description: Domain-level reads over the knowledge graph: node/edge context assembly, money-tie and law-verdict derivation, and the glyph/layout/source-link helpers that turn kg rows into renderable graph geometry.

contexts.name: PGlite Repositories
contexts.description: Repository layer over the embedded Postgres schema: DDL, row mappers and internals, plus per-domain repositories for the knowledge graph, votes, vote tags, provenance, review state and analysis outputs.

contexts.name: PGlite Store & Runtime
contexts.description: The embedded-Postgres store bootstrap: connection config, the store facade, loader-guard/readiness checks that prevent a failed first open from poisoning the process, and prop-narrowing helpers.

contexts.name: Archived Art Direction (Rentgen)
contexts.description: The Rentgen runner-up visual direction kept as a living reference at the noindexed /rentgen route, exploring an alternate money-graph treatment.

contexts.name: Shared Display Primitives
contexts.description: Domain-agnostic UI building blocks used across every feature: animated score readouts, rank-delta badges, source-citation notes, section headings/rules and the empty-data placeholder.

contexts.name: Custom ESLint Rules
contexts.description: Project-specific lint rules enforcing token discipline, no-silent-catch, a11y keydown handling on role-button elements, reduced-motion fallbacks, and the server-only import boundary.

contexts.name: Test Utilities & Loader Coverage
contexts.description: Server-only import stubs for the vitest environment and the colocated loader test that pins the leaderboard loader against a seeded PGlite instance.

contexts.name: App Bootstrap & Global Styles
contexts.description: The root layout, fonts and global stylesheet/design tokens that every route inherits.

contexts.name: i18n & Number Formatting
contexts.description: Czech-first locale configuration and the number/decimal-comma formatting helpers that every rendered figure in the app routes through.
